topic: Power supplies and schematic symbols (G7A; 13 pool questions)

questions.question: What is the function of a power supply bleeder resistor?

choices.A: It acts as a fuse for excess voltage
choices.B: It discharges the filter capacitors when power is removed
choices.C: It removes shock hazards from the induction coils

questions.answer: It discharges the filter capacitors when power is removed

questions.question: Which of the following components are used in a power supply filter network?
Which type of rectifier circuit uses two diodes and a center-tapped transformer?
What is characteristic of a half-wave rectifier in a power supply?

choices.B: The ripple frequency is twice that of a full-wave rectifier
choices.C: More current can be drawn from the half-wave rectifier
choices.D: The output voltage is two times the peak input voltage

questions.question: What portion of the AC cycle is converted to DC by a half-wave rectifier?
What portion of the AC cycle is converted to DC by a full-wave rectifier?
What is the output waveform of an unfiltered full-wave rectifier connected to a resistive load?

choices.A: A series of DC pulses at twice the frequency of the AC input
choices.B: A series of DC pulses at the same frequency as the AC input
choices.C: A sine wave at half the frequency of the AC input

questions.answer: A series of DC pulses at twice the frequency of the AC input

questions.question: Which of the following is characteristic of a switchmode power supply as compared to a linear power supply?

choices.A: Faster switching time makes higher output voltage possible
choices.C: High-frequency operation allows the use of smaller components

questions.answer: High-frequency operation allows the use of smaller components
